name: Elevated Repertoire (Monster)
body:
Prerequisites(s): At least one racial Hit Die, spell-like ability from race.

Benefit(s): Choose up to three spell-like abilities you possess. You gain a total of 3 additional uses of these spell-like abilities divided as you choose (for example, a hezrou with this feat could grant 2 additional uses per day to its blasphemy spell-like ability and 1 additional uses per day to its summon spell-like ability).
